theorem Roth.Θ_unique_le.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Unique σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {q : σ → ℕ}, 1 < q default → ∀ {r : σ → ℕ}, Roth.Θ B q r ≤ Real.log B / (↑(r default) * Real.log ↑(q default)) :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] [Unique σ] {B} hB {q} hq {r} ↦
  Roth.Θ_le_of_forall_index_le hB fun x hR x_1 hh ↦
    Roth.index_unique_le_log_div✝ hq hR.left
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg LE.le
              (congrArg abs (congrArg Int.cast (coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ x ((uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ) x).natDegree))))
            B))
        (hR.right.right (Finsupp.single default ((uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ σ) x).natDegree)))
      (hh default)

THETAUNIQUE199_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Unique σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {q : σ → ℕ}, 1 < q default → ∀ {r : σ → ℕ}, Roth.Θ B q r ≤ Real.log B / (↑(r default) * Real.log ↑(q default))
